text: 黄金年龄。
en: The golden age.

text: 肩负自已和家庭，步步为营前进就
en: Carrying oneself and one's family, advancing cautiously step by step.

text: 刚到40岁的时候会感慨时间飞逝，觉得自己怎么这么老了，会有岁月的感伤心，会有自感衰老的得失心。
en: When first reaching 40, one laments how time flies, feeling how old one has become, with a sentimental ache over the passing years and a sense of gain and loss at one's own ageing.

text: 但过了这阵子心里调试期间后，会觉得豁然开朗，意识到这个年龄段似乎进入了人生最佳的时期：少时的追求，这个年龄段已然实现，功稍成、名稍就，物质基础也比较扎实，可以摆脱名利心的驱使，去做一些有意义、有价值、自己真心想去做的事情。
en: But after getting through this period of mental adjustment, one feels suddenly enlightened, realising that this age seems to have entered the best period of life: the pursuits of youth have by now been realised, with modest achievement and some recognition, and a fairly solid material foundation, freeing one from the drive of fame and gain to do things that are meaningful, valuable, and truly wished for.

text: 同时，到了这个阶段，经历过风雨和人情冷暖，感受过得失与世间的美好，体察过人性与遗憾纠结，会更加成熟、从容的去面对身边的人和事，更加清淡、冷静的看待名利得失，更容易实现自洽、自足、自在、自省、自乐。
en: At the same time, having reached this stage, having weathered storms and the warmth and coldness of human relations, having felt both gain and loss and the beauty of the world, and having observed human nature and the tangle of regrets, one faces the people and matters around one with greater maturity and composure, views fame and gain with more detachment and calm, and more readily attains self-accord, self-sufficiency, ease, self-reflection, and self-contentment.

text: 总而言之，人到中场，半缺半满半自安，力求不要黑化，不要掉坑，既要选好未来人生的发力点，也要活在当下、享受当下，继续努力做一个温暖的人，努力让这个世界因自己的存在而变得更美好一点点 。
en: In short, at the middle of life, half lacking, half full, and half at peace, one strives not to turn dark, not to fall into pitfalls, must both choose well the point of effort for the life ahead and live in and enjoy the present, continuing to strive to be a warm-hearted person, and striving to make the world a little bit better for one's having been in it.

text: 马上到四十，以前会对突然冒出的白头发会恐慌，会对脸上的细纹恐慌，会对大姨妈量减恐慌。
en: Approaching forty, in the past I would panic at sudden grey hairs, panic at fine lines on my face, and panic at a lighter menstrual flow.

text: 也会思考人活着的意义。
en: I also ponder the meaning of being alive.

text: 现在反而越来越坦荡了。
en: Now, on the contrary, I have grown ever more open and at ease.

text: 因为有被父母爱着，又被孩子们爱着，又被身边一些真诚的朋友爱着。
en: Because I am loved by my parents, loved by my children, and loved by some sincere friends around me.

text: 觉得很幸运。
en: I feel very fortunate.

text: 目前和老公关系更像亲人，有着共同育儿的目标，一致的三观。
en: At present my relationship with my husband is more like that of family, with shared goals in raising our children and aligned values and outlook.

text: 足够了。
en: That is enough.

text: 当然他也有缺点，但优点大过缺点。
en: Of course he has faults too, but his strengths outweigh his faults.

text: 我也有一堆缺点，但都被亲朋好友包容着。
en: I too have a pile of faults, but they are tolerated by my family and friends.

text: 内心封存了一些美好的回忆。
en: Within, I have sealed away some beautiful memories.

text: 渐渐也看淡很多事，也会刻意和同事保持距离。
en: Gradually I have grown indifferent to many things, and deliberately keep my distance from colleagues.

text: 更专注于家人，尤其是孩子们。
en: I focus more on my family, especially the children.

text: 也有欣赏敬佩喜欢的人，向他们看齐。
en: There are also people I admire and like, and I measure myself against them.

text: 当然身边一直也有烂桃花，成年人也懂得分寸，刻意保持距离。
en: Of course there are always undesirable romantic entanglements around, but as an adult one knows the proper bounds and keeps a deliberate distance.

text: 不过是动物本性而已。
en: It is merely animal nature.

text: 都能理解。
en: All of it can be understood.

text: 现在只希望一家人健康平安。
en: Now I only hope that the family stays healthy and safe.

text: 除了卷运动，其它开心就好。
en: Apart from competitive working out, just being happy with everything else is enough.

text: 少内耗，自愈与自律，就会自由。
en: Less internal friction, self-healing and self-discipline, and one will be free.

text: 人到中年，尤其要注意自己的身体，这个时候不再像以前那样扛造了。
en: In middle age, one must pay special attention to one's body, for at this time it no longer endures hardship as it once did.

text: 万一生病了，上有老下有小，还真生不起病。
en: Should one fall ill, with the old above and the young below, one genuinely cannot afford to be ill.

text: 有必要在正常的医保外，再给自己上一份重疾险或者各地推出的惠民险（安徽这边是皖惠保），不限健康状况。
en: It is necessary, beyond ordinary medical insurance, to take out a critical illness policy for oneself, or one of the citizen-benefit schemes introduced in various places (in Anhui it is the Wanhui Bao), with no restriction on health status.

text: 减少不必要的外交，有一两个知心朋友足矣，闲时吃吃饭喝喝酒，关键时刻能帮上忙。
en: Cut down on unnecessary socialising; one or two close friends are enough, to eat and drink with in leisure time and who can lend a hand at critical moments.

text: 该置的房产也该置了，置不了的就多留点现金，以备不时之需。
en: The property that ought to be bought should be bought, and what cannot be bought, keep more cash in reserve for unforeseen needs.

text: 还有两年，但真心感受到步入中年了。
en: There are still two years to go, yet I genuinely feel that I have stepped into middle age.

text: 心态各方面都和年轻时不一样，不再那么冲动遇到任何事都会先冷静思考，更加注重自身生活和健康，越来越明白人这一生是一个慢慢凋落的过程，年轻的时候可以自信说大话，但是现在再也不会了，尤其对身体特别看重。
en: One's mindset in every respect is different from youth; no longer so impulsive, one thinks calmly first when anything happens, pays more attention to one's own life and health, and increasingly understands that life is a process of slowly withering; in youth one could confidently boast, but now one never would, and especially values one's body.

text: 每年都热衷检查身体，对每个指标都很重视，不厌其烦的去看医生问各种问题，自己喜欢研究琢磨问题，久而久之对任何事都了然入心。
en: Every year I am keen to have check-ups, taking every indicator seriously, tirelessly going to the doctor to ask all sorts of questions; I enjoy studying and pondering matters, and over time come to understand everything thoroughly.

text: 这个年龄不再强求任何东西，亲情友情爱情？
en: At this age one no longer insists on anything—family affection, friendship, romantic love?

text: 可能很多家庭伴随父母的养老以及家庭琐事兄弟姐妹之间会慢慢产生嫌隙，大家基本都各过各的日子，看重自己的口袋，再也感受不到童年的亲情。
en: Perhaps in many families, along with the care of ageing parents and household trivialities, rifts slowly grow between brothers and sisters; everyone essentially lives their own life, values their own purse, and can no longer feel the familial affection of childhood.

text: 对于友情大家都很忙，多年难得一聚。
en: As for friendship, everyone is busy, and it is rare to meet once in many years.

text: 还有爱情早就不强求了，不再重视感情和自身感受，追求合适舒服，日子的舒适性。
en: And romantic love has long ceased to be insisted upon; no longer valuing feelings and one's own experience, one seeks what is suitable and comfortable, the ease of daily life.

text: 对很多事情看的很淡，两个人可以生活，一个人也可以过得很好。
en: One takes many things lightly; two people can live together, and one person can also live well.

text: 主要的精力都放在培养孩子和赚钱上。
en: One's main energy is devoted to raising the children and earning money.

text: 我深知如果孩子将来不成器就算我有再多钱日子也不快乐。
en: I deeply know that if the child amounts to nothing in future, I would not be happy no matter how much money I have.

text: 我更知道生活处处需要钱，没有了钱头都抬不起来，还知道谁也靠不住唯有自己。
en: I know all the more that life needs money at every turn; without money one cannot hold one's head up, and I also know that no one can be relied upon except oneself.

text: 所以一直很努力，好在有个好头脑可以不用吃苦，不用劳累就可以赚到钱。
en: So I have always worked hard; fortunately I have a good head, so I can earn money without suffering hardship or toil.

text: 我有什么体会呢，其实没有太多，因为自己足够努力，所以当下工作不辛苦，不用花精力去应付人和事，没有竞争没有压力，每天过着舒心的日子，过着知足常乐的生活。
en: What realisation do I have? In truth not much, because I have worked hard enough, so my present work is not arduous; I need not spend energy coping with people and affairs, there is no competition and no pressure, and every day I live a comfortable life of contentment and quiet joy.

text: 因为努力，有远见早早培养孩子独立的能力，如今他自己可以做任何事，每次去学校老师都是各种夸张，心里也算满足了。
en: Because of my effort and foresight, I cultivated the child's independence early, and now he can do anything himself; every time I go to the school the teachers are full of praise, and I feel fairly satisfied.

text: 生活里可以完全按照自己想法过日子，想吃什么想买什么不用和任何人商量。
en: In life I can live entirely as I wish, eating or buying whatever I want without consulting anyone.

text: 没有男人让我烦心，没有鸡零狗碎的生活，没有婆媳矛盾，总之如果远离男人确实会少很多很多烦恼。
en: No man troubles me, no fragmented trivial life, no mother-in-law conflicts; in short, staying away from men truly does spare one a great many worries.

text: 我有钱，有儿子，也有房子，有头脑，有能力，长相还不错，坚持锻炼，每天看着孩子长大，特别欣慰。
en: I have money, a son, and a home; I have a good head and ability, decent looks, and keep exercising; watching the child grow every day brings me special contentment.

text: 其实人一辈子追求什么呢，不过是追求一个自己满意可以按照自己想法生活的人生罢了。
en: In truth, what does one pursue all one's life? Merely a life one is satisfied with, a life one can live by one's own wishes.

text: 挺好！
en: Pretty good!

text: 人过四十，不问天意，不猜人心！
en: Past forty, one does not question heaven's will, nor guess at people's hearts!

text: 40+，人生开始慢慢沉淀，走入了更加安静、稳定的年岁。
en: 40-plus, life begins slowly to settle, entering quieter, steadier years.

text: 岁月不仅带走了年少的时光，也净化了我们身上的戾气和脸上的浮躁。
en: The years have not only carried away the time of youth, but also purified the animosity within us and the restlessness on our faces.

text: 该经历的，该磨难的，都走过…
en: What was meant to be experienced, what was meant to be endured, has all been walked through…

text: 性格开始慢慢的变柔软，态度慢慢的变淡然，是成长，也是沉淀。
en: One's character slowly grows softer, one's attitude slowly grows more placid; it is growth, and also settling.

text: 一个人到底会有一个什么样的命运，什么样的结局，都属于不可知的事情。
en: What sort of fate and what sort of ending a person will ultimately have are both unknowable matters.

text: 与其被这些虚无缥缈的东西乱了心智，不如专心当下，专注手头的事情。
en: Rather than let these illusory things disturb one's mind, it is better to focus on the present and concentrate on the task at hand.

text: 很多时候，我们之所以感觉身心疲惫，是因为我们总是认为拥有得越多，就会越幸福。
en: Much of the time we feel mentally and physically exhausted because we always believe that the more we possess, the happier we will be.

text: 其实不然，过多冗杂的东西，只会让我们疲倦不堪。
en: In fact it is not so; too many superfluous things only weary us beyond endurance.

text: 人到中年，学会修剪自己，人生之路才会更加美好轻盈。
en: In middle age, one must learn to prune oneself, so that the path of life becomes more beautiful and light.

text: 1.制定目标，深耕自己。
en: 1. Set goals and cultivate oneself deeply.

text: 杰克·特劳特在《定位》中说：“如果什么都做，将会一事无成。
en: Jack Trout says in Positioning: 'If you do everything, you will accomplish nothing.

text: 最好聚焦于一个东西，让自己成为独一无二的专家，而不是什么都干的通才。
en: It is best to focus on one thing, to make oneself a unique expert rather than a generalist who does everything.

text: 现实生活中，总有一些人想经历世间所有的精彩，这山望着那山高，最终却一事无成。
en: In real life there are always people who wish to experience all the wonders of the world, ever looking to the next hill as higher, yet in the end accomplishing nothing.

text: 而当我们愿意朝着一个方向磨砺自己的技能时，便会更容易获得成功。
en: Yet when we are willing to hone our skills in one direction, we more readily achieve success.

text: 2.调整心绪，稳定内核。
en: 2. Adjust one's mood and stabilise one's core.

text: 作家冯唐说：“每个人都要有个笃定的核，这样在宇宙间，才不易被风吹散。
en: Writer Tang Feng says: 'Everyone must have a settled core, so that amid the universe one is not easily scattered by the wind.

text: 支撑一个人完成人生逆风翻盘的，往往是他内心的不妥协。
en: What sustains a person through life's reversal and comeback is often the inner refusal to compromise.

text: 人生下半场，修炼一颗强大而稳定的内核，人生才会越走越顺。
en: In the second half of life, by cultivating a strong and stable core, life's path grows ever smoother.

text: 3.放弃无效社交，缩小圈子。
en: 3. Give up ineffective socialising and narrow one's circle.

text: 年轻时，我们总忙着在各种社交场合觥筹交错，觉得多个朋友多条路。
en: In youth we were always busy mingling over drinks at various social occasions, feeling that one more friend means one more path.

text: 可实际上，大多数社交，非但无法给你带来成长，而且还会消耗你的时间和精力。
en: Yet in truth, most socialising not only fails to bring you growth, but also consumes your time and energy.

text: 作家余秋雨说：“在人际交往上，经常减肥排毒，才会轻轻松松地走以后的路。
en: Writer Qiuyu Yu says: 'In human interaction, regularly cutting back and clearing out lets one walk the road ahead with ease.

text: 生活中，无关紧要的应酬，能推就推；消耗心力的社交，能免则免。
en: In life, unimportant social engagements should be declined where possible; socialising that drains one's spirit should be avoided where one can.

text: 与其在推杯换盏的饭局里蹉跎时光，不如把有限的时间用来充实自己、陪伴家人。
en: Rather than waste time at banquets of toasting and exchanging cups, it is better to use one's limited time to enrich oneself and be with family.

text: 人至中年，我们要学会精简圈子，把那些不重要的人请出生命。
en: Reaching middle age, we must learn to simplify our circle and usher those who do not matter out of our lives.

text: 当你将更多的精力放在重要的人和事上时，人生的道路才能越走越宽，内心也会越来越丰盈。
en: Only when you put more energy into important people and matters will the path of life grow wider, and your heart ever fuller.

text: 人到中年，你需要明白，少即是多。
en: In middle age you need to understand that less is more.

text: 适时为生命做减法，卸下心中的负累，给心灵松绑，才能为自己赋能。
en: Timely subtract from life, lay down the burdens of the heart, loosen the bonds of the spirit, so as to empower oneself.

text: 余生漫漫，把生命调到极简模式，是爱自己最好的方式，也是最智慧的活法。
en: The remaining life is long; tuning life to a minimalist mode is the best way to love oneself, and the wisest way to live.
